query:
SELECT u.user_id AS "user_id: QsUserId"
                FROM qs_user_record u
                WHERE u.user_id = (
                        SELECT c.user_id FROM qs_client_record c
                        WHERE c.client_id = $1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
                    )
                    AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                FOR SHARE OF u
